name: The Chess Club
description: Regulars at the chess club each swear by a different opening, a favourite tactic, and a prized set. Work out who plays what.
clues: The player with the Rosewood set's rating is immediately next to the player known for the Back-rank mate.
The player with the Glass set's rating is lower than both Mikhail and the player known for the Back-rank mate.
Vera's rating is at least 200 more than the player known for the Smothered mate.
The player known for the Back-rank mate's rating is higher than both Mikhail and the player with the Glass set.
